page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 24 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 24 vCPUs. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10 percent. However, the instance leverages its 24 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression benchmarks all placing in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, as well as PassMark memory and database operations, consistently perform at average levels.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads that can exploit multi-threaded execution rather than relying on high single-core clock speeds. Given the lack of local storage and GPU accelerators, this instance is suited for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate multi-threaded data processing. It can also handle light LLM inference tasks, though text generation speeds for larger models remain limited.
